title: Anchor Reconciliation Engine
details: Compare stored credential anchors with latest on-chain state, detect mismatches, repair by re-submitting anchors or flagging issuer.

title: Multi-Realm Anchor Manager
details: Support anchoring to primary (VitalCV chain), secondary (public Ethereum/Polygon), and fallback realms. Track provenance in VC metadata.

title: Multi-Realm Anchor UI
details: Display a tiered trust badge with on-chain, cross-chain, and fallback realm statuses.

title: Anchor Integrity Model
details: Detect suspicious anchor timing, orphan anchors, stale extrinsics, or inconsistent signer authority.

title: Public Anchor Publisher
details: Publish Merkle roots of batched VC anchors to Ethereum via RPC or contract ABI.

title: Surge Detection Engine
details: Analyze job postings, facility alerts, shift gaps, and credential inactivity to detect workforce surges.

title: Surge Response Router
details: Notify eligible clinicians with privileges matching facility surge requirements.

title: Surge Alert UI
details: Provider receives emergency credential request or shift need with privileged-eligibility.

title: Burnout & Attrition Predictor
details: Analyze workload, renewal timing, privilege volatility, and FitScore trends to detect risk of clinician attrition.

title: Stability Insights Panel
details: Show clinicians their StabilityScore with recommendations to avoid risk.

title: Credential Drift Simulator
details: Simulate future deterioration of credential trust based on PSV drift, expired evidence, sanction risk, and issuer confidence.

title: Organizational Drift Dashboard
details: Issuer sees future risk of credential instability across provider roster.

title: Shift Scheduling Engine
details: Match provider availability, privileges, license status, and job settings to assign shifts.

title: Shift Acceptance UI
details: Provider accepts/declines shifts with real-time eligibility enforcement.

title: Shift Assignment Console
details: Facility admins assign shifts using eligibility filters and FitScore-powered recommendations.

title: Clinical Experience Logger
details: Track each shift as a VC-backed clinical experience log for long-term skill assessment.

title: Experience-Based Competency Engine
details: Evaluate provider competency growth using shift logs, privileges, training, and time-in-role.

title: Competency Progress UI
details: Show progress across competencies: ICU-ready, Telehealth-ready, Leadership-ready, Surgery-ready.

title: Leadership Qualification Engine
details: Evaluate provider strength for leadership roles using performance, credentials, tenure, privilege history.

title: Leadership Recommendations UI
details: Show department leaders recommended clinicians for leadership opportunities.

title: International License Mapper
details: Map overseas licensure to US equivalent categories. Include equivalency confidence score.

title: MobilityScore Engine
details: Compute provider’s mobility potential based on telehealth, interstate compacts, and international equivalencies.

title: Mobility View
details: Provider sees where they can practice today and where they can become eligible.

title: ATS Credential Bundle Generator
details: Bundle VCs + SD-JWT + anchor proofs into recruiter-friendly packet.

title: ATS Integration Console
details: Employers configure ATS mappings, API keys, and webhook interactions.

title: Marketplace Recommendation Engine
details: Suggest credentials providers should earn to unlock higher-paying roles or increase FitScore.

title: Career Advancement UI
details: Provider receives actionable suggestions for achieving next-level opportunities.

title: Privilege Renewal Engine
details: Auto-renew privileges when underlying credentials are renewed and PSV evidence is fresh.

title: Privilege Drift Detection
details: Detect inconsistencies in privilege eligibility and notify issuers.

title: Privilege Drift Dashboard
details: Issuer portal shows drift list, required actions, and upcoming issues.

title: Credential Diff Viewer
details: Show changes between VC versions with anchor proofs and timeline references.

title: VC Version Control
details: Implement version pointers, backward compatibility, and anchor tracking across upgrades.

title: PSV Result History
details: Store all PSV results historically and show trend of verification outcomes over time.

title: PSV Trend View
details: Visualize a provider’s PSV quality and drift over time.

title: Job Market Trend Engine
details: Analyze trends in job postings, specialties, salaries, privileges, and geographic needs.

title: Compensation Forecast Model
details: Predict salary ranges for providers based on credential portfolio and market conditions.

title: Employer Economic Dashboard
details: Show expected compensation ranges, hiring costs, credentialing ROI metrics.

title: Fraud Pattern Detector
details: Identify suspicious credential activity: rapid-credential churn, mismatched specialty paths, anchor failures.

title: Fraud Investigation Console
details: Compliance UI with suspicious events, VC graph anomalies, anchor inconsistencies.

title: Provider Reputation Engine
details: Compute ReputationScore from experience logs, issuer quality, PSVs, privileges, sanctions, and verification reliability.

title: Reputation Badge UI
details: Display provider’s reputation level with reasons, anchor trust, and timeline accuracy.

title: Chain-Synced Snapshots
details: Snapshot provider state and credential graphs periodically with anchor metadata.

title: State Snapshot Viewer
details: Issuer/executive UI showing historical trust-state snapshots with diffs.

title: API Latency Monitor
details: Track slow endpoints, chain RPC delays, and long PSV requests; auto-label risk zones.

title: Worker Queue Autoscaler
details: Autoscale background workers depending on DAG load, PSV volume, and anchor submissions.

title: Safe Mode Toggle
details: If critical infrastructure fails (chain, DB, PSV), enter read-only mode with proper messaging.

title: Safe Mode UX
details: Display reduced functionality banners when backend enters Safe Mode.

title: Dead Letter Queue
details: Capture failed DAG tasks and allow administrators to retry or inspect root cause.

title: DLQ Console
details: Admin view of failed tasks, their context, and retry controls.

title: Golden Path Test Part 3
details: Simulate surge detection, job matching, drift detection, chain failures, and fallback pathways.
